articles.title: Sabrina Carpenter Says Goodbye to Her Hero Dolly Parton
articles.summary: Sabrina Carpenter is heartbroken after Dolly Parton died. They made a music video together and became friends. Sabrina says Dolly was 'an angel walking the earth.'

articles.title: Google's New Foldable Phone: Should You Upgrade? Probably Not!
articles.summary: The Pixel 11 Pro Fold is a great phone, but if you have the 10, don't bother. It's only a little better. But first-time foldable buyers will love it!

articles.title: A Queen Built a Magic Cave to Make Her Family Seem More British
articles.summary: Queen Caroline built a cave with wax figures of Merlin and King Arthur to make her German family seem more British. It was weird, but it worked as a clever PR trick!
